input: Organize a family reunion for this summer

gold.taskTitle: Organize a Family Reunion This Summer
gold.taskDescription: Plan and coordinate a family reunion event to take place during the summer.

questions.title: How many family members are you expecting to attend?
questions.description: Understanding the headcount will shape venue, catering, and logistics decisions.

questions.title: Which month or dates are you targeting this summer?
questions.description: Pinning down a timeframe is essential for booking venues and sending invitations.

questions.title: Do you have a specific location or city in mind?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred location helps narrow down venue options and travel arrangements.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the reunion?
questions.description: A budget figure will guide decisions on venue, food, activities, and decorations.

questions.title: Will guests need overnight accommodation arranged for them?
questions.description: Knowing whether lodging is needed determines whether hotels or rental homes must be coordinated.

questions.title: What type of setting do you prefer for the event?
questions.description: For example, a backyard, a park, a rented hall, or a resort each require different planning steps.

questions.title: Are there specific activities or traditions you want included?
questions.description: Knowing desired activities such as games, a cookout, or a formal dinner shapes the event schedule.
